exposure: indication for the crash caesarean section
cohort: The study included all category one caesarean sections performed in Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2018.
finding: The mean decision-to-delivery interval (DDI) was 114.4 minutes, with no significant association found between DDI and adverse perinatal outcomes, but a significant association was observed between the indication for the crash caesarean section and adverse perinatal outcome.
mod_finding: For category one caesarean sections, the mean decision-to-delivery interval was significantly longer than the recommended 30 minutes, yet this prolonged interval had no significant impact on perinatal outcome in this study.
